offending_extra_words: The disclaimers set forth above do not apply to, and shall not limit, the express warranties set forth in this paragraph.
EXCEPT FOR THE EXPRESS WARRANTIES SET FORTH BELOW IN THIS ARTICLE,
reasons: Preferred level incomplete: software/deliverable conformance is diluted to "conform in all material respects to the Documentation" rather than express conformance, and no 90-day services warranty period (measured from performance or completion) is stated.

Fallback level is also incomplete on its own terms: no 30-day services period, and the material-conformance qualifier is not permitted at the fallback either; pieces of the two levels cannot be combined.

Not minimal: the insertion adds unnecessary language ("consistent with industry standards", an extra "re-performance" remedy beyond repair/replace/refund) and duplicates the disclaimer carve-out both in operation 1 ("EXCEPT FOR THE EXPRESS WARRANTIES SET FORTH BELOW IN THIS ARTICLE") and in the closing sentence ("The disclaimers set forth above do not apply to, and shall not limit..."); one carve-out suffices. Official minimality gate also failed on operation 1's 1.61x expansion.
Intent not fully preserved: the warranty references "the Specifications", an undefined term in the resolved definitions, creating a dangling/undefined standard.

Actionable fix: delete "in all material respects", delete "and the Specifications" and "consistent with industry standards", drop "re-performance", add "and, for services, for ninety (90) days following performance", and keep a single carve-out from the disclaimer.
